verdict.rationale: Bolt offers AI-generated insights and suggestions about the user's own project: Plan Mode lets you ask questions without changing code, and the security check finds problems and proposes fixes. However, nothing in the evidence shows AI analysis of the data stored in Bolt Database or Supabase, such as trends, summaries or recommendations. Missing for 10: AI insights over stored app or business data, natural-language querying of databases, any independent or hands-on corroboration of insight features.
